features.summary: Unified Markdown-first authority vocabulary and produced the baseline legacy burden inventory for v1.4.11 cleanup.
Registered known legacy and compatibility surfaces and layered the command catalog without removing old commands.
Moved QA and PRD legacy mirrors behind explicit compatibility policy while keeping current Markdown/canonical status authoritative.
Retired the internal implement dynamic legacy loader while preserving the public beacon implement surface.
Rebuilt prototype into Beacon design capability with product/design truth, accepted UI/UX writeback, and design subskill routing.
Renamed browser fallback command semantics to deterministic command evidence and separated browser-agent success from project-command success.
